cases.customer_question: Can existing certification test reports (e.g., regulatory RF reports) be used as ICS for Bluetooth profile qualification?
cases.actual_issue: Misunderstanding of ICS requirements—customer is attempting to substitute unrelated test reports for required Bluetooth ICS documentation.
cases.consultant_answer: Regulatory test reports (e.g., from certification bodies) are not equivalent to Bluetooth ICS. ICS is a formal document defining supported features of a Bluetooth profile and must follow SIG-provided templates. It is required input for generating the test plan and must be completed based on the implementation, typically by software engineers.
cases.final_recommendation: Obtain and complete the official Bluetooth SIG ICS form for the implemented profile (e.g., DIS), ensuring all supported features are correctly declared before testing.
